test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to improve it. If no improvement is required, select ‘No improvement required’.

By next summer, I will have completed my internship and __will have returned to school.__
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the tense consistency is important.
 
• The sentence uses the future perfect tense** "will have completed**", so the second clause should maintain the **same tense consistency.**
 
• Therefore, the use of "will have returned" is redundant and incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct form should be "**returned to school"** to maintain the parallel structure and proper tense usage.

Hence, the correct statement is '***By next summer, I will have completed my internship and returned to school.**'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When using the **future perfect tense**, ensure the verbs in the sentence maintain tense consistency.
 
• For example, **"I will have finished my work and gone home" is correct, while "I will have finished my work and will go home"** is not.
